scenarios.name: 🛒 Order Processing
scenarios.description: E-commerce flow: validation, inventory check, payment, database, notifications (parallel). Use ?fail=true to simulate payment failure.

scenarios.name: 👤 User Registration
scenarios.description: Complete registration: validation, DB check, create user, parallel setup (profile, settings, avatar), notifications. Use ?failEmail=true to simulate email retry.

scenarios.name: 📊 Report Generation
scenarios.description: Data pipeline: parallel API fetches, data aggregation, PDF generation, parallel delivery (S3, email, Slack). Use ?timeout=true to simulate API timeout.

scenarios.name: Nested: Product Page
scenarios.description: A product page loads the product, then three sections at once, each with requests of its own. The page's code ends after 2.5 s, but it completes only with the last request below it: a parent waits for its children (structured concurrency).

scenarios.name: Parallel: Dashboard
scenarios.description: Five dashboard widgets load at the same time and finish one by one; the dashboard renders once the slowest is in. 31 s of requests take 14 s.

scenarios.name: Cancellation: User Closes the Screen
scenarios.description: The profile screen loads the avatar, the friends and the activity feed. The user closes it after 6.5 s, which cancels the screen and every request still running under it; settings sync, outside the screen, carries on.

scenarios.name: Deep Nesting: Search Indexer
scenarios.description: A search indexer walks /home/ana/projects/vizcore/backend/src, one folder deeper at a time, and completes the folders from the deepest up as each adds its subfolder's results (configurable depth).

scenarios.name: Sequential and Parallel: Checkout
scenarios.description: Checkout validates the cart; then reserves the stock, charges the card and calculates shipping at once; then creates the order and sends the receipt, one after the other.

scenarios.name: Exception: One Backend Call Fails
scenarios.description: The account page loads five things at once. 12 s in, the loyalty service answers HTTP 500: the failure cancels the requests still loading and fails the page, while what already arrived stays done.

scenarios.name: Dispatchers: Photo Thumbnails
scenarios.description: Three photos arrive 2 s apart; each is downloaded on Dispatchers.IO, resized on Dispatchers.Default and uploaded on IO again. Feeds the Dispatcher Overview: see dispatcher selection and thread assignment.

scenarios.name: Rendezvous: Chef and Waiter
scenarios.description: The chef hands each plate to the waiter at the pass, a channel with no room: a plate changes hands only when both are there. The waiter waits for the first plate; after that the chef waits for the waiter with each plate.

scenarios.name: Buffered Channel: Print Queue
scenarios.description: The office sends 8 jobs to a print queue with 5 slots, faster than the printer prints. The queue fills up, the office waits for a free slot, and the printer drains the queue.

scenarios.name: Fan-Out: Support Desk
scenarios.description: 12 support tickets go into one queue read by 3 agents. Each ticket goes to exactly one free agent; in the morning rush all three are busy and new tickets wait in the queue.

scenarios.name: Simple Flow: Stock Ticker
scenarios.description: A stock ticker: a cold flow sends six prices to each screen that collects it; a second screen gets its own run from the first price.

scenarios.name: Flow Operators: Search as You Type
scenarios.description: Search as you type: keystrokes are debounced, short queries filtered out, and the rest mapped to search results, in that order.

scenarios.name: StateFlow: Shopping Cart
scenarios.description: A shopping cart: the total always has a value, and a checkout page that opens later gets the latest total at once.

scenarios.name: SharedFlow: Notifications
scenarios.description: Notifications: every open screen gets each one at the same moment; a screen opened later gets only what comes after.

scenarios.name: Retry with Backoff: Weather Forecast
scenarios.description: The weather server is overloaded and turns down the first three tries. The app retries with exponential backoff, waiting 0.75 s, 1.5 s and 3 s, and the fourth try gets the forecast.

scenarios.name: Producer-Consumer: Coffee Bar
scenarios.description: The cashier puts orders on a rail with room for 3 and the barista makes them, each at their own pace. In the morning rush the rail fills and the cashier waits; in the quiet spell the barista waits for orders.

scenarios.name: Fan-Out / Fan-In: Holiday Album
scenarios.description: 9 photos go to 3 resizers, each photo to exactly one (fan-out). The album collects the finished photos through one channel in the order they are done, not the order they were picked (fan-in).

scenarios.name: Supervisor: Nightly Backup
scenarios.description: Photos, contacts and messages back up side by side under supervisorScope. The message backup fails, and photos and contacts keep going: one child's failure does not cancel its siblings.

scenarios.name: Circuit Breaker: Payment Provider
scenarios.description: The payment provider is down. After 3 failed charges the breaker opens and rejects orders at once for 5.5 s, then lets one trial order through; the provider is back, so the breaker closes.

scenarios.name: Thread-Safe Counter: Festival Gates
scenarios.description: Three gates count festival visitors into one shared count. Each update holds a lock while it reads, shows and writes the count, so the other gates wait for it, suspended, and no visitor is lost.

scenarios.name: Bank Account Transfer: Household Bills
scenarios.description: Anna and Ben send each other money. Each transfer locks both accounts, always Anna's first, so the transfers queue instead of deadlocking; the one Ben cannot afford is declined.

scenarios.name: Cache Read-Through: Product Prices
scenarios.description: Eight requests for two prices meet an empty cache. The first miss loads a price under the lock; the others wait, check again and find it cached; later requests read the cache without the lock. Two loads in all.

scenarios.name: Deadlock Demo: Two Transfers at Month End
scenarios.description: Anna pays Ben and Ben pays Anna, each locking the payer's account first. Each holds one account and waits, suspended, for the other's. After 10 s a watchdog cancels both.
